original_contract.efficient_matrix: Existing SAV offline mother check suffices for ten-yards/loadout fields; no extra UI or native save for these fields.
original_contract.interpretation: Combining actual positive operation of unchanged candidate hardware and native growth retention satisfies this named retention check without asserting high-L execution. It does not prove movement-while-building, new paid construction, maximum jump range or cooldown termination.
